''Toxophoenix'' [[Heinrich Wilhelm Schott|Schott]] }} [[File:Astrocaryum sciophilum MHNT.BOT.2018.28.7.jpg|thumb|''Astrocaryum sciophilum'' ([[MHNT]])]] '''''Astrocaryum''''' is a [[genus]] of about 36[http://www.kew.org/wcsp/qsearch.do?plantName=Astrocaryum&page=quickSearch Kew Palms Checklist: ''Astrocaryum''] to 40 species of [[Arecaceae|palm]]s native to [[Central America|Central]] and [[South America]] and [[Trinidad]].{{cite journal| last = Kahn| first = Francis| year = 2008| title = The genus ''Astrocaryum'' (Arecaceae)| journal = Revista Peruvana de Biología| volume = 15| issue = supl. 1| pages = 31–48| doi = 10.15381/rpb.v15i3.2851| issn = 1727-9933| url = http://sisbib.unmsm.edu.pe/BvRevistas/biologia/v15sup1/pdf/a04v15sup1.pdf| quote = no}} ==Description== ''Astrocaryum'' is a genus of [[Thorns, spines, and prickles|spiny]] palms with [[pinnate]]ly compound leaves–rows of leaflets emerge on either side of the axis of the leaf in a feather-like or fern-like pattern. Some species are single-stemmed, while others grow in multi-stemmed ([[caespitose]]) clumps. They are pleonanthic—they flower repeatedly over the course of their lifespan—and [[Plant sexuality|monoecious]], meaning that there are separate male and female flowers, but individuals plants bear both types of flowers. ==Taxonomy== ===History=== The [[type (biology)|type species]], ''Astrocaryum aculeatum'', was first described by [[German people|German]] [[botanist]] [[Georg Friedrich Wilhelm Meyer]] in 1818 based on a specimen from the [[Essequibo River]] in [[Guyana]].{{cite journal| last = Bernal| first = Rodrigo| author-link = Rodrigo Bernal| year = 2008| title = (1837) Proposal to conserve the name ''Astrocaryum aculeatum'' (''Palmae'') with a conserved type| journal = Taxon| volume = 57| issue = 3| pages = 997–98| quote = no| doi = 10.1002/tax.573035| doi-access = free| Pulle *''[[Astrocaryum scopatum]]'' F.Kahn & B.Millán *''[[Astrocaryum sociale]]'' Barb.Rodr. *''[[Astrocaryum standleyanum]]'' L.H.Bailey *''[[Astrocaryum triandrum]]'' Galeano-Garces, [[Rodrigo Bernal|R.Bernal]] & F.Kahn *''[[Astrocaryum ulei]]'' Burret *''[[Astrocaryum urostachys]]'' Burret *''[[Astrocaryum vulgare]]'' Mart. {{div col end}} One well known member of the genus is ''[[Astrocaryum vulgare]]'', typical in the [[Pará]] state of [[Brazil]]. ''[[Astrocaryum mexicanum]]'', a common palm of the [[Caribbean]] coast of Central America, is known as ''warree cohune'' in [[Brazil]], as its spines are said to resemble the bristles of the [[white-lipped peccary]] or ''warree''. ==Uses== The fruit and seeds of several species are used for human food, oil production and fish bait. Leaves are used as a source of fibre and stems as building material. Species are also used medicinally and as a source of [[Heart of palm|palm heart]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Arecaceae genera}} {{Taxonbar|from=Q2716557}} {{Authority control}} [[Category:Astrocaryum| ]] [[Category:Arecaceae genera]] [[Category:Flora of the Neotropical realm]] {{Cocoseae-stub}}
